name: Big Bass Splash

features.name: Random modifiers
features.description: At the start of free spins, random modifiers can add extra fish, extra fishermen, extra spins or raise the level.

features.name: Collect free spins
features.description: Fisherman wilds collect fish values; every fourth wild advances the multiplier.

review:
The original Big Bass collect bonus, with a twist: random modifiers can upgrade the free spins before they start – more fish, more fishermen and so on – so every bonus plays out a little differently.

The cap goes up to 5,000x and the RTP is a strong 96.71%. For most players, this is the most balanced game in the whole series: still simple, but with more variety than the original.
cons: Still largely a re-skin of the original
author: editorial-team
